version: LOCK 71 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the scholar's notebook, chapter 8: Mercy and the weak
builds_on: LOCK 3 (page 1, read with Idris), LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 51 (the last page). Every reference checked on sunnah.com; the game never shows the reference.

words.find_kicker: The scholar's notebook · a page found
words.find_title: A page in the scholar's hand
words.read_button: Read the scholar's page with Idris
words.story: Idris turns back through the pages. “{t}”

chapter.title: Mercy and the weak
chapter.story: He spent a year in a hospital town writing letters for the sick to their families.

pages.saying: The first thing on Eid al-Adha is to pray, then go back and sacrifice; whoever does that has followed our way.
pages.idris: Prayer first. Then the sacrifice. Order matters.
pages.found: Sumayya found a page lining an old hat bought from a pedlar.

pages.saying: One Umrah to the next wipes out what came between them, and an accepted Hajj has no reward but Paradise.
pages.idris: Idris on Hajj because of you. I still can't believe it.
pages.found: Rami hands you a loaf wrapped in an old page. “Look at the writing on this.”

pages.saying: Fear Allah concerning these animals that cannot speak; ride them when fit and eat them when fit.
pages.idris: Ayyub's donkey. It couldn't speak, so you did.
pages.found: Faris found a folded page in a crack while mending a wall. “It's in a scholar's hand. You'll know who wants it.”

pages.saying: A man found a dog panting with thirst, filled his shoe with water and gave it a drink. Allah thanked him and forgave him.
pages.idris: A dog. A shoe. Forgiveness. Nobody saw you at the well.
pages.found: Children are flying a kite made from an old page. Dawud buys it from them for a date and gives it to you.

pages.saying: I and the one who looks after an orphan will be in Paradise like this - and he held two fingers together.
pages.idris: Usama. Faris. Yusuf. Two fingers, side by side.
pages.found: Usama found a page pressed inside a second-hand book.

pages.saying: Avoid the seven destroyers - among them consuming an orphan's wealth.
pages.idris: Hakam's new roof. The qadi was right.
pages.found: Ma'n has been using a page to wrap spices and has only just noticed the writing.

pages.saying: The believers in their love and mercy are like one body: when one part aches, the whole body feels it with sleeplessness and fever.
pages.idris: When Shifara had the fever, Ilmara couldn't sleep either.
pages.found: Jamal pulls a damp page from the bottom of a basket and dries it for you.

pages.saying: A Muslim is a brother to a Muslim: he does not wrong him or hand him over; whoever helps his brother's need, Allah helps his.
pages.idris: Fadil at the quay. You didn't hand him over.
pages.found: Umm Yahya found a page under a loose floor tile.

pages.saying: When Allah wants good for someone, He tests him with hardship.
pages.idris: The hard year. I don't say it to make it lighter. I say it because it's true.
pages.found: Hakam was given a debt note - and the scholar's page is written on the back of it.

pages.saying: How wonderful is the believer's affair - all of it is good: in ease he is thankful, in hardship he is patient, and both are good for him.
pages.idris: Thankful in the good years, patient in the bad. Ilmara learned both.
pages.found: Hafsa's little one folded a page into a paper boat. Hafsa dried it out for you.
